# Record JAH-AMS-000024 — verifies its own structure and governing principle
record = {
    "id": "JAH-AMS-000024",
    "title": "Selection Workflow",
    "ladder_rank": 6,
    "edition": "signature",
}
principle = ("Corrosion is a design load", "")
key_points = [
    "Requirements \u2192 candidate screening (Ashby charts) \u2192 detailed trade \u2192 testing: a repeatable process replacing tribal knowledge.",
    "Corrosion is a design load: Galvanic couples, exfoliation, and stress-corrosion are treated as loads in material choice \u2014 coatings and isolation are part of the selection.",
    "Application: Trading weight vs cost on new designs",
    "Ladder rank 6/6 (complex) \u2014 the most complex synthesis \u2014 full professional depth",
    "Capstone record of this ladder section",
]
assert isinstance(record["id"], str) and record["id"].startswith("JAH-AMS-"), "bad id prefix"
assert 1 <= record["ladder_rank"] <= 6, "ladder rank out of range"
assert record["edition"] in ("public", "signature"), "bad edition"
assert len(key_points) >= 4, "key points incomplete"
assert all(isinstance(k, str) and len(k) > 20 for k in key_points), "key point too thin"
print("Record:", record["id"], "-", record["title"])
print("Edition:", record["edition"], "| Ladder rank:", str(record["ladder_rank"]) + "/6")
print("Governing principle:", principle[0])
if principle[1]: print("  Relation:", principle[1])
for i, kp in enumerate(key_points, 1): print(str(i) + ". " + kp)
print("OK: JAH-AMS-000024 verified — full record, no drift")
demo.note: Runnable verification program: checks record structure and prints the governing principle.

provenance: JAH Databases Project Three — Aircraft Materials Selection Database; Signature-generated completion, labeled as such, never presented as authentic public record.
combination_capability: Turns airframe requirements into ranked material choices: for each part, strength-to-weight, fatigue life, corrosion behavior, and cost are scored together so the selected alloy or composite is justified, not guessed.
